methods.label: Interpret the size of the statistic
methods.explanation: The greater the deviation from the assumption of independence, the larger the statistic. Whether to reject the assumption also requires comparison with a critical value.
methods.levelReason: This uses the high-school interpretation of the independence-test statistic without calculating a distribution or significance level.
